note: PLACEHOLDER. This is not the SDN list. `authoritative: false` is the fail-closed marker: packages/screening refuses to issue a CLEAR against a non-authoritative source, so a deployment that never ran the fetch script cannot clear anybody, which is the correct behaviour and not a bug to work around. Populate it with `npm run fetch:ofac -w @fee-split-vaults/catalog`. The real list is roughly 17k entries and about 2 MB; it is deliberately not checked in, because a committed copy would look authoritative for exactly as long as it took to go stale, and `publishedAtUnix` is taken from OFAC's own publish date rather than from our download clock so the staleness gate measures the right thing.
